bibliographic_hint: Laing, Ellen Johnston. "Problems in Reconstructing the Life of Qiu Ying." Ars Orientalis 29 (1999).

bibliographic_hint: Laing, Ellen Johnston. "Sixteenth-Century Patterns of Art Patronage: Qiu Ying and the Xiang Family." Journal of the American Oriental Society 111, no. 1 (1991).
